children: Microsoft announced a shift to two reportable segments—Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer—and provided restated FY26 results plus FY27 Q1 adjusted outlook.
Company will report two segments in FY27: Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer to better reflect AI-driven operations.
Presentation furnishes restated historical financials showing FY26 revenue of $331,839m and FY26 Agents and Infra revenue of $268,127m.
Investor metrics updated: Azure, Microsoft 365 commercial, Industry solutions and Search & advertising definitions changed to reflect moved services.
FY27 Q1 outlook mechanically adjusted for new structure: Agents and Infra revenue $75.15–75.75b; Devices and Consumer $14.7–15.2b; total company revenue ~$89.85–90.95b.
Metric and product reporting changes include moving GitHub cloud and Security Copilot into Microsoft 365 commercial cloud and LinkedIn ad/subscriptions into Search and advertising.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Microsoft updates FY27 reporting to two segments, restates FY26 results and provides FY27 Q1 outlook
